name: Charm & Chatter
tagline: Italian charm friendship bracelets, made in pairs.
howItWorks: Come alone or with a friend. If you come alone, we pair you with someone whose charm taste matches yours.
Each of you gets your own stainless steel base bracelet: 18 plain links.
Pick four photo charms that say something about you, and pop out four plain links to make room.
Clip the charms in, swap stories with your partner, and take your bracelet home.
pairingRule: Pairs are matched by charm preference.
materials: Four photo charms each, from a shared table of designs
Spare links for adjusting the fit
